item_reviews.comment: T1 r3 beats FOCUS, ZeroEmbed and MeanEmbed on all six accuracy metrics and has lower WikiText bits per byte.
k=64 is below baseline on all seven metrics, including WikiText, which is worse because it is higher. GSM8K falls from 0.5588 to 0.1463.
The direction of every change matches T1. The XNLI and Lambada drops are tiny (0.0002) and well within the standard errors.
Method M is best on MMLU, ARC-C, Belebele and WikiText. FOCUS is higher on GSM8K (0.0174 vs 0.0144).
The ties and the 0.0001 MMLU gap against MeanEmbed are accurate. The Belebele and WikiText advantages are small.
ARC-C is identical, MMLU is 0.0033 lower, and GSM8K, Belebele and WikiText are worse than the original.
The package reports no statistical tests, a single evaluation per model, and no standard errors for the listed metrics.
